reviewer.name: Independent Jiuwudaishi 011 final canonical date auditor

summary: Complete fresh independent canonical audit of all 57 Jiuwudaishi 011 Chinese source units, 93 temporal and active-date-hint checks, and 34 people after curation. The repaired reception records are correctly separated from life chronology: seven posthumous events remain, including the distinct AD 938 release and burial of the Last Emperor’s head. Liu Chong and his mother retain only the AD 883 Bian-command context. Dated investitures and the AD 915 death of Virtue Consort Zhang are source-supported at year precision. The audit is research-blocked, not approved: the source-specific holds for Zhu Wen, Princess Changle, and Princess Puning correctly decline to invent Western personal activity dates, so dedicated chronology research is still required.
